name.description: The internal name of the measure, same as the field name.

description.description: A longer description of the measure, suitable as a tool tip or other help text.

accessor.description: An accessor to retrieve the measure value (or null if not recorded).

unitPicker.description: A function to choose the most appropriate unit for a value.

valueFormatter.description: A function to format a value with the specified unit.

title:
Measures can be accessed and formatted by name, which allows more compact formatting. Each supported measure is
represented by an instance of this type (returned by #allMeasures and #recordedMeasures).
name: MicrobenchResult.Measure
